dominance_rule: j epsilon-dominates i iff j_k >= i_k - epsilon for all jointly available objectives and j_k > i_k + epsilon for at least one objective.
epsilon_zero_relation: epsilon=0 reduces to ordinary Pareto nondominance.
legacy_column_note: The recommender keeps pareto_efficient as a backward-compatible column alias, but from Phase 13 ranking outputs it denotes the same canonical epsilon-Pareto membership as near_pareto.
missing_objectives: Dominance is evaluated only on objectives jointly available for the candidate pair; a pair with no common objective is not comparable.
nondominated_rule: A candidate is epsilon-Pareto / near-Pareto when no other candidate epsilon-dominates it.
normalization: Per candidate set and objective: clip to the 5th/95th percentile, scale to [0,1], and invert minimize objectives so higher is better.
